records.text: On April 22, 2023, the user asked for an explanation of the difference between MIDI and MP3 files.

MIDI files contain musical instructions, such as notes, pitches, and timing, rather than recorded audio. They are generally small and need a device or software to interpret the instructions and generate sound. MP3 files contain compressed digital audio and can be played directly on most devices. MIDI can encode musical details such as expression and articulation; MP3 represents audio rather than editable musical instructions.
